goal: Localize small-model errors in the 220-match published VETT corpus by running controlled batches against local Ollama models, scoring against original scorecards, and auto-selecting the next batch from prior results. External API must remain 0.

data_links.scorecard_fields_43: match.result/toss/pom + per innings (team,total_runs,total_wickets,overs,byes,leg_byes,no_balls,wides) + per innings top3 batter name/runs + per innings top2 bowler name/wickets/runs = 43

split.rule: Any root in the held-out range is refused by the planner. Method development uses pools.dev and pools.hard only. Held-out evaluation is a separate phase and must not share roots with these batches.

gold_source: scorecard.md parsed by pilot_lib.parse_scorecard_full; 43-field schema reused from attribution_update_and_full_table/full_table.py

hypotheses: H1: target cells on dev roots are near ceiling under original text.
H2: hard-root failures are context-dilution failures, recoverable by a 3-sentence evidence excerpt.
H3: if H2 fails, failures are field binding/localisation rather than long-context dilution.
H4: deleting the same-innings mid-score hurts more than a matched unrelated deletion.
H5: target-cell saturation can coexist with large 43-field collateral loss.
